strong.description: Bold lead rendered before the text (e.g. a term being defined). If omitted, a 'Lead — rest' / 'Lead: rest' prefix in `text` is auto-bolded.

color.description: Hex colour for this bullet's marker + lead (overrides the card tone).

icon.description: Icon reference used as the bullet marker (replaces the dot).

glyph.description: Single-char marker instead of the dot: '✓' (green), '✕' (red), '≈'/'△' (amber), '→', etc.
